name: com.unifan.ide.zed
description: Code editor integration for supporting Zed and Wu (Zed fork) as code editor for Unity. Based on com.unity.ide.visualstudio@2.0.29, adds support for SDK-style csproj generation, Unity Roslyn analyzers, MSBuild pipeline integration, auto discovery of Zed & Wu installations, and automatic .zed/.wu settings & debug configurations.
